workflow.api: official Tripo OpenAPI v2 established project client

visual_qa.attempt_1: Axial muzzle and stock projections exist, but both side views and top/bottom views collapse into sparse detached islands. The receiver, barrel, support tube, right trigger grip, left support corridor, and stock do not form one usable connected weapon. The apparent muzzle opening is capped at the center axis.
visual_qa.attempt_2: Same gross front/back fusion failure as Attempt 1. Opaque solid renders confirm this is missing/disconnected geometry rather than texture alpha or material visibility. The muzzle is capped and the main body and both grip corridors are absent or split from most oblique views.
visual_qa.crown_armor: The crown silhouette is only coherent in the axial projection; it is not a continuous non-clipped shell around a valid barrel in side/isometric views.
visual_qa.stock_left_muzzle_forward_axis: The raw long axis remains X with nominal muzzle at -X and stock at +X, but the weapon structure along that axis is not usable or connected.
visual_qa.salvage_assessment: Repair would require reconstructing the muzzle bore, barrel, receiver, stock, right-hand trigger grip, left-hand support corridor, and most transitions. That is a new manual model rather than design-preserving Blender cleanup, so postprocessing and decimation were not attempted.

preservation.approach: Both candidates and QA artifacts were isolated under Regeneration_20260826/Subculture. Existing Production and Unity assets were preserved in place because neither candidate passed the raw gate.
